# Ertone Plastics Ltd

> UK injection moulding company in Aylesbury since 1982. Precision moulded plastic parts on 100 - 600 tonne presses, from design and tooling to volume production, assembly and closed loop recycling.

Ertone Plastics Ltd is an ISO 9001 certified injection moulding company at Unit 3 Telford Close, Aylesbury, Buckinghamshire HP19 8DS, established in 1982 (Companies House 01677534). Phone 01296 431482, email enquiries@ertoneplastics.co.uk.

Key facts. Billion and Haitian presses from 100 to 600 tonnes with robot arms, parts from 1 gram to 4 kilograms, materials PC, PP, GPPS, ABS and nylon, high quality clear parts, tool transfer, design and prototyping, printing, welding, assembly and packing, and a closed loop recycling system with free collection. Supplier to the largest UK airlines for over 30 years.

## Services
- [Injection moulding](https://ertone.co.uk/services/injection-moulding): Precision parts made at volume, with tight tolerances and a finish that holds up batch after batch.
- [Tool manufacture](https://ertone.co.uk/services/tool-manufacture): Production tools designed, built and trialled. Or move your existing tool to Ertone.
- [Design and prototype](https://ertone.co.uk/services/design-prototype): Test the idea early. We design, refine and prototype so the final part works first time.
- [Secondary operations](https://ertone.co.uk/services/secondary-operations): Print, weld, assemble, pack and dispatch, so parts leave ready to use.
- [Closed loop recycling](https://ertone.co.uk/services/closed-loop-recycling): We collect used and damaged products, recycle them and mould the material into new parts.

## Also available
- [Vacuum forming](https://ertone.co.uk/services/vacuum-forming): Large, lightweight parts formed fast. Ideal for trays, covers and housings in short or medium runs.
- [Fabrication and assembly](https://ertone.co.uk/services/fabrication-assembly): Fabrication and assembly for parts that need more than moulding, from single components to finished assemblies.

## Sectors
- [Aerospace](https://ertone.co.uk/sectors/aerospace): Lightweight, tough components made for life at 35,000 feet and thousands of turnarounds.
- [Construction](https://ertone.co.uk/sectors/construction): Buckets, trowels, scrapers and mallets built for life on site.
- [Automation](https://ertone.co.uk/sectors/automation): Small precision parts that keep automated systems running smoothly.
- [Sports](https://ertone.co.uk/sectors/sports): Durable, lightweight parts for sporting equipment, accessories and fixtures.
- [Defence](https://ertone.co.uk/sectors/defence): Components made to specific material and performance requirements.
- [Hospitality and catering](https://ertone.co.uk/sectors/hospitality-catering): Mugs, glasses and cutlery built to survive busy kitchens, dishwashers and daily service.
